binary_lineage: All 30 rendered suites use the same final Linux executable. The Windows PE is rebuilt from the frozen C++ sources; portable verification compares it with a fresh stripped linked binary. Earlier failed diagnostics are retained separately.
corrections: A first phase-entry implementation reset/skipped root displacement and prevented running kicks. Phase selection now preserves the physical path clock, and explicit near human kicks reach the unchanged geometric feasibility test.

New body-proxy unit coverage initially assumed every deepest limb contact points along actor-center separation. Overlapping articulated arms can have a different local surface normal; the corrected assertion requires actual overlap, bounded penetration and a unit horizontal normal. No existing gameplay assertions or ball contact tolerances were weakened.

Receiving anticipation now yields to authored actions and braced hands, without accumulating a hidden pose. The solo possession fixture updates last-touch ownership and predictions. Early grip-force telemetry records actual short interactions.

The pressure regression requires real bounded reciprocal surface contacts when shoulders/arms stop the opponent before the old root capsule overlaps; knockdown, force and reach assertions remain intact.

F12 previously collided with the global renderer quit shortcut; normal F12 now reaches the comparison while Ctrl+F12 remains an explicit global exit. The camera samples the rendered root offset exactly once.

The aerial fixture originally demanded a ShortPass header even when the native CPU chose a valid defensive Interfere header. Validation now requires a native aerial decision plus an actual head action with same-tick skin contact, allowing pass, shot or defensive clearance; accidental body deflections do not count.
limitations: Rendered validation uses Linux/X11/software OpenGL and a virtual Xbox controller. The Windows PE and its DLLs/assets are checked; Windows GUI and a physical controller are not executed here.
No Euphoria implementation, equivalence, neural motion synthesizer or reinforcement-trained physical controller is claimed.
Native selection filters remain authoritative; phase jumps are restricted to stable non-contact locomotion, while actions retain authored entry/contact frames.

Physical upper-body tracking, kinematic root/legs with IK, motorized articulated falls and assisted authored recovery remain a hybrid controller. Actor body contests use finite posed proxy overlaps and reciprocal force feedback, not a unified full-mesh collision simulation.
27206 native indexed frames and 6274 contextual profiles are not new motion captures. The learned metric held-out pair test is not gameplay realism accuracy.

MotionMatching.zip exceeds the 32 MiB download limit and was not inspected. The three small Unity settings/meta files contain references, not a motion bank. No Unity package decompilation or port is claimed.
Downloaded OrangeDuck demo motions and pretrained networks were not imported or used in training.
